messages.subject: Different and negative DIC value
parts:
Hi,

After updating the testing version of INLA, the DIC values are different from my previous results, and some DIC values become negative. Since DIC is defined as Bayesian deviance and the effective number of parameters, I think both terms are supposed to be positive. Is it possible to generate negative DIC values? If I want to check the DIC and Bayesian deviance values, is there any methods that I can do it in R-INLA package?

Thank you for your help.

Regards,

Jingwei Lu

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Different and negative DIC value
parts:
The DIC/WAIC values are very sensitive to any changes are its a sum (of often many terms) and not an average. 

You have an example I can rerun and check?

—
Haavard Rue
